summary.text: Thomas Egan, an Independent Party of Connecticut candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Connecticut's 3rd Congressional District to Rosa DeLauro.
Egan received 2.9% of the vote to Rosa DeLauro's 61.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
